Office Hours
If you would like to discuss the course material, have questions about the course or how you are doing, or simply want to chat, I would be happy to meet with you. Available hours are posted in Canvas. If you cannot make the posted times, email me to set up a different time that works for both of us.
Preferred Contact Method
Email. I always want to hear from you, but at certain times of the semester the volume of email becomes large. If you email me and don't hear back within two business days, please send a follow up email. I will appreciate the kind reminder.
